last_rebaseline.reason: Revert the e2e-matrix gate wiring: adding it changed the combined rules@ hash, which staled the pins of 7 open cards, and the task gate blocks on stale pins with no CLI exit for those cards (duplicate ids, govrail #352). Wiring the matrix therefore depends on a cleanable card ledger, which needs govrail 0.47.2. Restoring the pre-wiring constitution; the matrix stays enforced by docs/register until then.
